description: Chart a Sentry issue's events and affected users over time, like the graph on the issue page. Returns every bucket of both series, and MCP Apps hosts show it as an interactive chart.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

period.description: Relative time window, e.g. `24h`, `7d`; defaults to 14d.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: render_issue_chart

incomplete.description: Indexes into `times` of buckets still receiving data, whose values may rise.

outsideRetention.description: Indexes into `times` of buckets that start before the retention window, so older data is missing and the value will not change.

peak.description: Highest bucket that is no longer receiving data; null for grouped charts.

series.description: One series per measure or top group, most events first.

count.description: Events behind this series; null when not measured. A small count means a noisy series.

label.description: The group's value, or what the series measures.

total.description: Sum of all buckets; null for non-additive aggregates.

values.description: One value per entry of `times`; null where the bucket has no data.

times.description: Start of each bucket, oldest first; shared by every series.

tool.description: Tool that drew this chart; changing the range calls it again.

valueType.description: Such as integer, number, duration, percentage, or size.

title: Render Issue Chart
